text:
maya: Quick thread  took a pass on the slope-band chart in Console. Main problem: legend is too verbose and competes with slope-band labels.
jonah: I noticed that too. On narrow viewport the legend wraps to two lines and pushes the chart down.
lia: Can we collapse the legend by default for small multiples? Maybe a tiny chevron that expands on click/hover.
pat: +1. Also the slope bands use full opacity which obscures gridlines and the zero baseline. Suggest 40% fill so lines remain readable.
samir: Accessibility: the band fills need clearer ARIA. Screen readers currently say just "band" for each series which is meaningless.
a11y-bot: Suggested aria phrasing: "slope band for <series name>, range <min> to <max>, baseline <median>". Keep under ~120 chars.
maya: For the legend trigger microcopy I drafted "Show series details" / "Hide series details". Thoughts?
lia: Prefer shorter: "Details" / "Hide" with a visually-hidden label like "Details for series <name>" for screen readers.
jonah: Implementation nit: collapsing must preserve keyboard order. Tab into a collapsed legend, Enter expands and focus moves to first legend row.
pat: On smoothing: current toggle is global. Can we add per-chart override: "smoothing: auto | on | off" so specific charts can opt out?
samir: Helpful for metrics where smoothing hides spikes. Add inline hint: "Smoothing hides brief spikes; toggle off to inspect anomalies." small muted copy under toggle.
maya: UX question: when outlier dimming is on some dots look like bugs. How do we surface that?
lia: Suggest a subtle badge near the legend: "Outlier dimming on". Clicking it opens a tooltip with threshold and a "configure outlier policy" link.
jonah: Threshold UI idea: a slider with a live sample preview and a tiny sparkline thumbnail that updates as you move it. Makes impact obvious for PMs.
pat: Dev constraint: GPU-rendered canvas expects opacity controlled in shader; avoid per-point DOM style changes. Use a uniform alpha for band fills and a mask texture for per-series dropout. I'll post infra note.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist entry: "legend toggle: aria-expanded; focusable; focus contrast >= 4.5:1; descriptive aria-labels for bands; keyboard expand/collapse".
samir: Tooltip copy tweak: change "range" to "typical range (10th90th percentile)" or "expected range" to clarify what the band shows.
maya: Also add a small info icon next to the band label to open a short explanation, instead of overloading tooltip.
lia: Small-multiples layout: when legend is collapsed, align chart tops so rows line up vertically. Currently varying legend heights break alignment.
jonah: Implementation approach: fixed collapsed legend height + overflow hidden with gradient fade and "show more" link for long lists.
pat: CSS accessibility note: ensure the legend toggle focus ring color meets 4.5:1 contrast; current pale blue fails AA.
maya: Action items: 1) Lia to draft microcopy and hidden-label phrasing. 2) Samir to prepare ARIA copy and checklist. 3) Pat to prototype shader alpha approach and share perf notes. 4) Jonah to spec collapse interaction and keyboard behavior. I'll update a small Figma screen later. :thumbsup:
lia: I'll post copy variants in #design once mockups are up.
samir: I'll add a short a11y test plan and pair with QA on keyboard flows.
pat: I'll ping eng-runtime with shader notes and a perf run summary.
jonah: I'll make a tiny PR for the collapse toggle and demo in staging.
maya: Thanks all  aiming to ship legend/contrast/smoothing/outlier tweaks next sprint.
jonah: :rocket:
